title: 1940s Family Group Outside Brick Wall, Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo 1949
description: A black and white vintage snapshot showing a family group standing closely together outdoors against the light brick exterior of a home. Dated June 14, 1949, on the reverse, the photograph features four women and a man wearing typical post-World War II casual dresses, aprons, and button-up shirts, capturing everyday American family life in the late 1940s.
